task_title: Emergency CI delivery fix: make conflict serialization opt-in (unfence). Ejection loop + proactive rebase deliberately deferred after adversarial plan review forced a major fork.

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review rejected the 3-part plan and forced a major fork. Verified in code: (F1) promotePrefix returns {promoted:false} whenever mainHealthAllowsPromotion() fails (reconcile.mjs:780, reattest at :819, third re-check reconcile-lib.mjs:651-658) - so a red main blocks the train from landing the very PR that fixes main. The original 3-part plan did not address this at all. (F3) Unfencing via R07 alone is insufficient: CI_CONFLICT_ORDER_WAIT_LABEL independently invalidates promotion at reconcile-lib.mjs:489-490 and verifyMergeSlot recomputes coordinator ordering at reconcile.mjs:820-825. (F5) Folding rebase into the fixer dispatch uses stale head evidence; the existing two-phase trusted-rebase dispatch is correct. F2 mechanism claim partly incorrect (in-place splice does preserve prefix candidates built before the ejection index) but the invariant-sensitivity argument stands, so ejection is de-prioritised out of the emergency PR. Alternatives enumerated: (1) sanitise branches at admission and retain coordinator, (2) replace filename fencing with exact synthetic merge proofs, (3) conservative cross-pass ejection instead of in-pass continue.

rounds.notes: High: default-off left already-armed auto-merge in place for ownership/human-gated PRs (coordinator blanket disarm was incidental protection). Fixed via ownershipGated carve-out. Medium: no regression test for merge-train kill-switch wiring. Fixed via 3 source-topology assertions.

Reviewers DISAGREED on the High finding. terra: removing the coordinator blanket disarm leaves an already-armed auto-merge live for human-gated PRs. opus-4.8: no significant issues - human approval is independently enforced at ci-recovery/reconcile.mjs:1171 with no coordinator dependency. Adjudication (verified in code, not accepted on assertion): opus is right that protection is not PERMANENTLY lost; terra is right that it is not TRANSACTIONAL - between the coordinator pass and the next ci-recovery pass an armed auto-merge can fire. Applied terras fix because it is strictly safer and cannot loop (ci-recovery only arms when clean and not human-gated, so it never re-arms against the disarm). Mutation-verified: reverting the carve-out makes the new integration test fail.
